preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized wallet) to call setMultipliers function
Contract must have trading enabled (tradingOpen = true)
Attacker must hold some LUNAINU tokens to execute transfers

exploit_hint: As an authorized user, call setMultipliers with _buy, _sell, or _trans set to 0. This will cause division by zero in takeFee function when calculating feeAmount = amount.mul(totalFee).mul(multiplier).div(feeDenominator * 100). Then execute token transfers to bypass fee collection, effectively allowing tax-free transfers and increasing your token balance relative to normal conditions.
